description.value: Merlins Bar and Grill has been a fixture on Blackcomb Way in Whistler since 1980, operated by Vail Resorts and positioned at the mountain base. The venue runs as two distinct spaces: a morning café serving brunch and espresso drinks, and a bar and grill open through après hours with a broad pub menu. Regular live music events — including resident bands — give it a lively, community-hub character that extends well beyond a typical resort restaurant.
